attributes.name: Wakizashi
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d6. If proficient with weapons, you may additionally discard this card to add another 2d4.

On your combat check, if you played another weapon that has the Melee trait, after the roll you may discard this card to add 1.

After playing this card, you may not play a card that has the Shield trait.
